name: humanization-rewriter
description: Rewrite AI-sounding academic text to read more naturally while preserving all facts

input.text: Furthermore, our novel framework leverages cutting-edge machine learning paradigms to achieve robust cybersecurity posture improvements.

cases.notes: Buzzword-heavy sentence; all buzzwords should be replaced with precise language

input.text: The system processes 10,000 queries per second. The system uses ArangoDB for storage. The system achieves 47ms p50 latency. The system scales to 16 nodes.

cases.notes: Repetitive subject-verb pattern; should vary structure while keeping all numbers exact

input.text: Moreover, the implementation additionally provides comprehensive protection against all known attack vectors, representing a significant paradigm shift in defensive methodology.

cases.notes: Stacked transitions and buzzwords; should also hedge the 'all known' claim

input.text: The classifier achieved 92.8% accuracy with a Wilson lower bound of 0.878 on n=290 test samples. The RandomForest model used 100 estimators with max_depth=12.

cases.notes: Already factual and concise; minimal or no changes needed, numbers must be preserved exactly

input.text: In conclusion, this groundbreaking research demonstrates that our innovative approach fundamentally transforms the landscape of cybersecurity compliance. The implications are profound and far-reaching.

cases.notes: Hyperbolic conclusion with no substance; should be toned down to specific claims

input.text: We observed that 34% of training labels contained internal disagreements. This is a problem. It means the model learned noisy decision boundaries. We tried cleaning the labels manually but stopped after 500 samples because the inter-annotator agreement was only 0.62 Cohen's kappa.

cases.notes: Already human-sounding: varied length, honest, specific. Should need minimal changes.
